description: Controller record of the pull request state as read-only GitHub reads showed it after a mechanical wait: identities, states, locations and links, nullable fields as GitHub gave them. A field that cannot be null missing from GitHub's answer failed the read, and each list matched the total count GitHub reported on every page with no key repeated, or nothing was recorded. It holds no bodies, logs or comment text. The Controller used no state or conclusion beyond the wait's test and judged nothing; their meaning is the reader's to judge

wait.description: The wait before the reads. Its only test was whether every check run was completed and every commit status was success, failure or error, on the same pull request head, at every poll for the settle window

outcome.description: settled: the test held for the settle window. timed_out: the wait reached its cap first, which is recorded and is not an error

polls.description: Polls that completed, failed ones included

failed_polls.description: Polls with a failed or unreadable read; each restarted the settle window

last_poll_error.description: The error of the last failed poll

last_polled_head.description: The pull request head of the last poll that read the state in full; a settled wait settled on it. Absent when no poll did

observed_at.description: When the reads of this record began, after the wait

number.description: The number of the committed pull-request record, which the read checked

head_sha.description: The head the check runs and commit statuses below are of

check_runs.description: Every check run of head_sha GitHub listed, ids unique

app.description: The slug of the app that created the check run

conclusion.description: As GitHub gave it; null until the check run completed

statuses.description: The latest commit status of each context of head_sha, contexts unique

unresolved_threads.description: The pull request's review threads GitHub shows as not resolved, in its order, ids unique

url.description: The link of the thread's first comment
